title: Bodhi Rook
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: A former Imperial cargo pilot from Jedha who found himself making kyber crystal runs to Eadu, Bodhi Rook risked everything to bring Galen Erso's information about the Death Star to Saw Gerrera, giving the Rebellion a chance to destroy it. Practical, but ever anxious, Bodhi had to muster his courage in order to fight against the Empire he used to serve.
